forms.name: severance tether
forms.description: The flail first flies 12 m on its tether and retracts, pulling every enemy it hits to the ring edge before the ring fires.

hypotheses.rationale: the prose gives no band width; the legacy geometry labels the whole 2 m inner radius to the outer radius ring as the edge, so the band is radius 550 - inner 200 = 350 cm
flight out and back over 12 m at the stock basic projectile speed 18 m/s: 2 x 1200 / 1800 s = 0.67 s = 40 ticks
the ring fires when the tether has retracted: the tether flight and retract time (40 ticks)

pulled to the ring edge (toPoint, radius 550): the farthest hit is at the 12 m tether range, so the longest pull is 1200 - 550 = 650 cm
a rigid flail tether has no stated damage limit; 0 means none (the flail convention never ties a target, so this is not read by main)
